section1.title: 1. PURPOSE AND SCOPE
section1.content: These terms govern the contracting and provision of software design, development and implementation services through tecnoredmx.com.mx. The services include requirements analysis, architecture design, application development, testing, implementation and initial technical support.

section2.title: 2. OBLIGATIONS OF THE PARTIES
providerItems: Develop the software in accordance with agreed specifications
Deliver the project within the established deadlines
Provide technical documentation and user manuals
Provide technical support during the period established in the contract
clientItems: Provide complete and accurate information for the development
Make payments according to the agreed schedule
Assign technical personnel for project coordination
Provide access to systems when necessary for integration
Perform tests and validations within the established timeframes

section3.title: 3. DEADLINES AND DELIVERABLES
section3.content: Development times will be determined based on the complexity of each project and will be communicated to the client in advance. Deliverables may include, as applicable, source code, executables, technical documentation and user manuals. Any modification to the originally agreed scope may result in adjustments to delivery times and costs.

section4.title: 4. ECONOMIC CONDITIONS AND PAYMENT METHOD
section4.pricesContent: Prices are expressed in Mexican pesos (MXN) and are subject to the current VAT.
section4.paymentContent: Payment may be made through the enabled platform, using credit card, debit card or other electronic methods indicated on the site at the time of purchase.

section5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
section5.intro: All intellectual property rights related to the developments, services and content generated through this site shall be governed by the following provisions:
items: Exclusive developments: Once the corresponding total payment has been made and confirmed, the developments and code created specifically for the client shall become their property.

Third-party tools: The tools, frameworks, libraries and other general-use components employed in the development shall at all times maintain the original licenses of their respective owners, without implying any transfer of additional rights to the client.
Use restrictions: The client may not reproduce, sublicense, commercialize or distribute proprietary components without the prior written authorization of their respective owners.
Company rights: The company shall retain all rights over its methodologies, processes, technical knowledge and know-how used or developed during the provision of services.

section6.title: 6. WARRANTY AND SUPPORT
warrantyItems: A 90-day warranty is granted against programming defects after final delivery
The warranty covers only documented and reproducible programming errors
It does not cover requirement modifications or issues arising from changes in the client's technological environment
supportItems: Support includes correction of documented errors and basic technical advice
Response time: 24-48 hours on business days
Support via email and scheduled phone calls

section7.title: 7. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
items: Liability is limited to the total amount paid for the service
No liability is assumed for indirect damages, loss of profit or information losses not directly attributable to defects in the developed software
The client is responsible for maintaining backups of their information
TECNORED is not responsible for service interruptions caused by third parties or force majeure

section8.title: 8. CONFIDENTIALITY AND DATA PROTECTION
items: Both parties agree to maintain confidentiality regarding technical, commercial and strategic information
Personal data shall be treated in accordance with the Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data
Confidential information may not be disclosed for a period of 5 years after the conclusion of the project
Appropriate security measures shall be established to protect the information

section9.title: 9. CHANGES AND MODIFICATIONS
items: Any modification must be agreed upon in writing
Changes in the project scope may imply adjustments in time and cost
A new quotation will be provided for significant modifications
Minor changes (less than 10% of the total value) will be included at no additional cost

section10.title: 10. DELIVERY AND ACCEPTANCE
items: Delivery is considered completed when the software complies with the agreed specifications
The client has 15 business days to make post-delivery observations
Without observations within the established period, the deliverable is considered accepted
Observations must be specific, documented and related to the original specifications

section11.title: 11. FORCE MAJEURE
items: Neither party shall be liable for non-compliance due to causes of force majeure
Force majeure causes include: natural disasters, pandemics, acts of authority, armed conflicts
The affected party must notify in writing within 5 days following the event

section12.title: 12. DISPUTE RESOLUTION
items: Disputes shall be resolved through mediation in the first instance
If no agreement is reached, they shall be submitted to commercial arbitration
Current Mexican legislation shall apply
The competent courts shall be those of Mexico City

section13.title: 13. COMMUNICATIONS
items: Official communications shall be made to the email: info@tecnoredmx.com.mx
Notices are considered delivered at the time of their sending
Changes to contact information must be notified in writing
A record of all project communications shall be maintained

section14.title: 14. GENERAL PROVISIONS
independenceItems: The nullity of any clause shall not affect the validity of the rest of the agreement
Null clauses shall be replaced by similar valid provisions
totalityItems: These terms constitute the complete agreement between the parties
They prevail over any prior oral or written communication
They may only be modified by written agreement signed by both parties
assignmentItems: Rights and obligations may not be assigned without written consent
The client will be notified of any relevant subcontracting

items: Data collected through the website is used solely for the provision of services

Users can configure their browser to reject cookies

section2.title: II. PRIVACY PHILOSOPHY
section2.intro: At TecnoRED we understand that your data is valuable and deserves protection. Our commitment is based on:
section2.transparency: We clearly explain what data we collect, why and how we use it, without confusing or ambiguous terms.

section3.title: III. TYPES OF INFORMATION WE COLLECT

serviceItems: Develop and deliver the requested software solutions
improvementItems: Optimize the experience on our website
Analyze the quality of our services

section5.title: V. LEGAL BASIS FOR PROCESSING
section5.intro: We process your personal data based on:
items: Your consent: For promotional communications and non-essential analysis
Contract execution: To fulfill contracted services
Legitimate interest: To improve services and prevent fraud
Legal obligations: To comply with tax and regulatory provisions

items: Technology service providers that help us operate
Technical collaborators under confidentiality agreements

Competent authorities when required by law

section7.title: VII. DATA SECURITY
section7.intro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your information:

section8.title: VIII. DATA RETENTION
section8.intro: We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to:
items: Fulfill the purposes for which it was collected
Satisfy legal and tax requirements
Resolve disputes and enforce our agreements
section8.footer: Specific periods vary according to the type of information and purpose, but generally do not exceed the deadlines established by applicable legislation.

section9.title: VIII. YOUR RIGHTS AS DATA SUBJECT
section9.intro: In accordance with the Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties, you have the right to:
items: ACCESS: Know what personal data we have about you and the characteristics of the processing.
RECTIFICATION: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
CANCELLATION: Request deletion of your data when you consider they are not necessary.
OPPOSITION: Object to the processing of your data for specific purposes.
LIMITATION OF PROCESSING: Request that we limit the use of your data in certain circumstances.
PORTABILITY: Receive your data in a structured and commonly used format.
REVOCATION OF CONSENT: Withdraw your consent at any time for processing that requires it.

section10.title: X. HOW TO EXERCISE YOUR RIGHTS
section10.intro: To exercise your ARCO rights or submit any privacy inquiry:
items: Full name and contact information
Clear description of your request
Documents proving your identity
If applicable, documents proving legal representation

section11.title: XI. COOKIES AND SIMILAR TECHNOLOGIES
section11.intro: Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to:
items: Improve site functionality
Analyze usage and performance
Personalize your experience
Remember your preferences
section11.footer: You can configure your browser to reject cookies, although this may affect some site functionalities.

section12.title: XII. MINORS
section12.content: We do not intentionally collect personal information from minors under 18 years of age. If we identify that we have collected data from a minor, we will delete it immediately.

section13.title: XIII. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY
section13.intro: We may update this Privacy Policy occasionally. Significant changes will be notified through:
items: Our website
During your next interaction with our services
section13.footer: The date of the last update appears at the beginning of this document.

section14.title: XIV. CONTROL AUTHORITY
section14.intro: If you consider that the processing of your personal data violates applicable legislation, you may file a complaint with the Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno (SABG), the authority that, as of March 21, 2025, assumed the functions of the former Instituto Nacional de Transparencia, Acceso a la Información y Protección de Datos Personales (INAI) regarding personal data protection held by private parties.

section15.title: XV. CONTACT
section15.intro: For any questions, comments or requests related to this Privacy Policy:

Subject: Privacy Inquiry
Response: Within 5 business days

privacyPolicy.footer1: This Privacy Policy has been prepared in accordance with the Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties, its Regulations and the applicable Privacy Notice Guidelines in the United Mexican States.

refund.intro1: At SOFTLOGIC we value the trust our clients place in us and we work to offer services of the highest quality. We know that unforeseen situations may arise, which is why we have established this Refund and Cancellation Policy with the objective of providing clarity, transparency and security in every process.
refund.intro2: Here you will find the conditions under which cancellations, refunds and retentions proceed, as well as the rights and responsibilities of both the client and SOFTLOGIC. Our commitment is to address each request fairly and promptly, always respecting applicable legislation and fostering a long-term relationship of trust.

section1.title: 1. Cancellation by the client
section1.content: The client may request cancellation of services at any time. In such cases:
items: Refunds will be subject to analysis of the actual project progress and costs already incurred.
Work actually performed and partial deliverables may be invoiced or retained until any outstanding balance is settled.
Once the corresponding payments are released, the client will be entitled to receive the progress and documentation generated to date.

section2.title: 2. Cancellation by SOFTLOGIC
section2.content: SOFTLOGIC may cancel the service in the event of:
items: Payment default by the client.
Serious breach of contractual obligations assumed by the client.
Improper use of the platform or harm to third-party rights.
section2.footer: In these cases, deliverables will be retained until full settlement and no refunds will proceed for services already rendered.

section3.title: 3. Cancellation due to force majeure
section3.content: In the event of extraordinary events (natural disasters, health emergencies, massive infrastructure failures, acts of authority or other causes beyond the parties' control), SOFTLOGIC may temporarily suspend services without liability. If the impossibility of execution persists, either party may request definitive termination, resolving payments and deliverables proportionally to progress.

section4.title: 4. Non-refundable services
section4.content: The following will not be subject to refund:
items: Third-party software licenses already acquired.
Domain, hosting or technology infrastructure services already consumed.
Consulting, analysis or advisory services previously rendered.
Third-party expenses previously authorized by the client.

section5.title: 5. Procedure for requesting a refund
section5.content: All requests must be submitted in writing to info@tecnoredmx.com.mx and include:
items: Client or company name.
Project or service contracted.
Reason for cancellation.
Supporting documentation, if applicable.
section5.footer: SOFTLOGIC will evaluate each request individually and will communicate the resolution to the client in writing within a maximum of 10 business days, detailing the authorized amount and the refund method.

section6.title: 6. Refund methods and timelines
section6.content: In case of approval, refunds may be made through:
items: Reversal to the original payment method (credit/debit card or bank transfer). Crediting times depend exclusively on the banking institution or card issuer, and may vary between one and several billing cycles.

section7.title: 7. Intellectual property and deliverables
section7.content: SOFTLOGIC will retain all rights over its own methodologies, processes and know-how. The client will acquire ownership of developments made specifically for their project once the corresponding total payment has been settled.

section8.title: 8. Policy modifications
section8.content: SOFTLOGIC reserves the right to modify this policy at any time. Updates will be permanently available on the website.

section9.title: 9. Legislation and jurisdiction
section9.content: This policy is governed by the applicable legislation in the United Mexican States. For any controversy, the parties submit to the competent courts of Mexico City, expressly waiving any other jurisdiction that may correspond to them.
